diff --git a/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.mjs b/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..c86f1361
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+/** CI-owned lifecycle dashboard. Network requires --apply or --validate. */
+import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { parseRelease } from '../../apps/web/scripts/build-with-release.mjs'
+
+const events = ['pwa_install_instructions_viewed', 'pwa_install_native_prompt_resolved', 'pwa_install_completed',
+  'pwa_update_available', 'pwa_update_dismissed', 'pwa_update_apply_requested', 'pwa_update_applied',
+  'release_notes_opened', 'release_notes_closed']
+const sql = (query) => ({ kind: 'DataVisualizationNode', source: { kind: 'HogQLQuery', query }, display: 'ActionsTable' })
+export const dashboardName = 'HatCast — Installation, mises à jour et nouveautés'
+export const marker = 'hatcast-managed:lifecycle-v1'
+export const insights = [
+  { key: 'events', name: 'Parcours installation et mise à jour', query: sql(`SELECT event, count() AS occurrences FROM events WHERE event IN (${events.map(e => `'${e}'`).join(',')}) AND {filters} GROUP BY event ORDER BY occurrences DESC`) },
+  { key: 'guidance', name: 'Aide installation : raisons et variantes', query: sql("SELECT properties.fallback_reason, properties.instruction_variant, count() FROM events WHERE event = 'pwa_install_instructions_viewed' AND {filters} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC") },
+  { key: 'versions', name: 'Dernière release observée par personne active', query: sql("SELECT release_id, count() AS persons FROM (SELECT person_id, argMax(properties.release_id, timestamp) AS release_id FROM events WHERE event = 'app_release_observed' AND {filters} GROUP BY person_id) GROUP BY release_id ORDER BY persons DESC") },
+  { key: 'lag', name: 'Personnes en retard — jours depuis la dernière release', query: sql(`WITH latest AS (
+    SELECT properties.release_id AS release_id, min(timestamp) AS released_at
+    FROM events WHERE event = 'hatcast_release_promoted' GROUP BY properties.release_id
+    ORDER BY released_at DESC LIMIT 1
+  ), observed AS (
+    SELECT person_id, argMax(person.properties.name, timestamp) AS name,
+      argMax(person.properties.email, timestamp) AS email,
+      argMax(properties.release_id, timestamp) AS release_id, max(timestamp) AS last_seen
+    FROM events WHERE event = 'app_release_observed' AND {filters} GROUP BY person_id
+  ) SELECT observed.name, observed.email, observed.release_id, observed.last_seen,
+    latest.release_id AS latest_release, greatest(0, floor(dateDiff('second', latest.released_at, now()) / 86400)) AS days_since_latest_release
+    FROM observed CROSS JOIN latest WHERE observed.release_id != latest.release_id
+    ORDER BY days_since_latest_release DESC, last_seen DESC`) },
+  { key: 'notes', name: 'Nouveautés — snapshot technique à l’ouverture', query: sql(`SELECT timestamp, person.properties.name, person.properties.email,
+    properties.release_id, properties.source, properties.viewport_width, properties.viewport_height,
+    multiIf(properties.$device_type = 'Mobile', 'phone', properties.$device_type = 'Tablet', 'tablet', properties.$device_type = 'Desktop', 'desktop', 'unknown') AS device_type,
+    properties.$os, properties.$os_version, properties.$browser, properties.$browser_version
+    FROM events WHERE event = 'release_notes_opened' AND {filters} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500`) },
+  { key: 'engagement', name: 'Nouveautés — temps visible et défilement', query: sql("SELECT properties.source, properties.visible_time_bucket, properties.scroll_bucket, count() FROM events WHERE event = 'release_notes_closed' AND {filters} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC") },
+]
+
+export function promotionPayload(token, release, date) {
+  if (!release || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(date))) throw new Error('Invalid release or promotion date')
+  const hash = createHash('sha256').update(`hatcast-release:${release.release_id}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 32)
+  return { api_key: token, uuid: `${hash.slice(0,8)}-${hash.slice(8,12)}-4${hash.slice(13,16)}-8${hash.slice(17,20)}-${hash.slice(20)}`,
+    event: 'hatcast_release_promoted', timestamp: date,
+    properties: { ...release, distinct_id: randomUUID(), $process_person_profile: false } }
+}
+
+export async function provision({ projectId, key, request = fetch, validate = false, report = () => {} }) {
+  if (!/^\d+$/.test(projectId ?? '') || !key) throw new Error('Missing PostHog project ID or private API key')
+  const root = `https://eu.posthog.com/api/projects/${projectId}/`
+  async function api(path, method = 'GET', body) {
+    const url = new URL(path, root)
+    if (url.origin !== 'https://eu.posthog.com' || !url.pathname.startsWith(new URL(root).pathname)) throw new Error('Unexpected pagination URL')
+    const response = await request(url, { method, headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000) })
+    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`PostHog ${method} ${url.pathname} failed (${response.status})`)
+    return response.json()
+  }
+  async function list(path) {
+    const items = []
+    while (path) {
+      const page = await api(path)
+      items.push(...page.results)
+      path = page.next
+    }
+    return items
+  }
+  const dashboards = (await list('dashboards/?limit=100')).filter(d => d.description === marker && !d.deleted)
+  if (dashboards.length > 1) throw new Error('Multiple CI-owned dashboards: reconcile before writing')
+  const dashboard = dashboards[0] ?? await api('dashboards/', 'POST', { name: dashboardName, description: marker, filters: { date_from: '-30d' } })
+  const existing = await list(`insights/?dashboards=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify([dashboard.id]))}&limit=100`)
+  for (const insight of insights) {
+    const description = `${marker}:${insight.key}`
+    const matches = existing.filter(i => i.description === description && !i.deleted)
+    if (matches.length > 1) throw new Error(`Duplicate CI-owned insight ${insight.key}`)
+    const body = { name: insight.name, description, query: insight.query, dashboards: [dashboard.id] }
+    const saved = matches[0]
+      ? await api(`insights/${matches[0].id}/`, 'PATCH', body)
+      : await api('insights/', 'POST', body)
+    if (validate) {
+      const computed = await api(`insights/${saved.id}/?refresh=force_blocking&from_dashboard=${dashboard.id}`)
+      if (computed.result === null || computed.result === undefined || computed.error) {
+        throw new Error(`PostHog insight ${insight.key} did not return a computed result`)
+      }
+      // No rows, person data, or raw event properties are written to CI logs.
+      report(`Validated insight: ${insight.key}`)
+    }
+  }
+  return dashboard.id
+}
+
+export async function main(args = process.argv.slice(2)) {
+  if (args.includes('--validate')) {
+    if (args.includes('--apply')) throw new Error('Choose validation or promotion, not both')
+    const id = await provision({ projectId: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID,
+      key: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, validate: true, report: console.log })
+    console.log(`Validated lifecycle dashboard_id=${id}; no promotion event sent`)
+    return
+  }
+  if (!args.includes('--apply')) {
+    console.log(JSON.stringify({ name: dashboardName, description: marker, insights }, null, 2))
+    return
+  }
+  const release = parseRelease(readFileSync(new URL('../../apps/web/public/version.txt', import.meta.url), 'utf8'))
+  const token = process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_API_KEY
+  if (!token) throw new Error('Missing PostHog project token')
+  // CI records the release only after successful Cloud Run deployment. Stable UUID dedupes reruns.
+  const payload = promotionPayload(token, release, process.env.HATCAST_PROMOTED_AT ?? new Date().toISOString())
+  const response = await fetch('https://eu.i.posthog.com/i/v0/e/', {
+    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20_000),
+  })
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`PostHog promotion capture failed (${response.status})`)
+  const result = await response.json()
+  if (result.status !== 1 || result.quota_limited?.length) throw new Error('PostHog promotion capture was not accepted without quota limits')
+  const id = await provision({ projectId: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID, key: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY })
+  console.log(`PostHog lifecycle dashboard: https://eu.posthog.com/project/${process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID}/dashboard/${id}`)
+}
+if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) main().catch((error) => {
+  // Never log HTTP bodies, headers, or tokens; our errors contain only operation/status.
+  console.error(error.message)
+  console.error('PostHog lifecycle synchronization failed; deployment unchanged. Check credentials and API access, then rerun the observability job.')
+  process.exitCode = 1
+})
diff --git a/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.test.mjs b/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.test.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..6e51d4f4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/v2/posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.test.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { parseRelease } from '../../apps/web/scripts/build-with-release.mjs'
+import { marker, promotionPayload, provision, insights, main } from './posthog-lifecycle-dashboard.mjs'
+
+test('bundle and promotion derive the same immutable identity', () => {
+  const release = parseRelease('2.6.2\nProduction build\nGit: 5009b980\nBuild: ignored')
+  assert.deepEqual(release, { release_id: '2.6.2:5009b980', app_version: '2.6.2' })
+  const a = promotionPayload('fake', release, '2026-10-18T12:00:00Z')
+  const b = promotionPayload('fake', release, '2026-10-18T13:00:00Z')
+  assert.equal(a.uuid, b.uuid)
+  assert.equal(a.properties.$process_person_profile, false)
+  assert.equal(parseRelease('<html>fallback</html>'), null)
+})
+
+test('provisioning creates once, then patches only its own insights', async () => {
+  const dashboards = [], savedInsights = [], writes = []
+  const request = async (url, options) => {
+    assert.equal(url.origin, 'https://eu.posthog.com')
+    const body = options.body ? JSON.parse(options.body) : null
+    const path = url.pathname
+    if (options.method === 'GET' && path.endsWith('insights/')) {
+      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(url.searchParams.get('dashboards')), [42])
+    }
+    let result
+    if (options.method === 'GET') result = { results: path.endsWith('dashboards/') ? dashboards : savedInsights, next: null }
+    else {
+      writes.push(options.method)
+      if (path.endsWith('dashboards/')) { result = { id: 42, ...body }; dashboards.push(result) }
+      else if (options.method === 'POST') { result = { id: savedInsights.length + 1, ...body }; savedInsights.push(result) }
+      else result = body
+    }
+    return { ok: true, json: async () => result }
+  }
+  const opts = { projectId: '123', key: 'fake', request }
+  assert.equal(await provision(opts), 42)
+  const first = writes.length
+  assert.equal(await provision(opts), 42)
+  assert.equal(dashboards.length, 1)
+  assert.equal(savedInsights.length, insights.length)
+  assert.deepEqual(writes.slice(first), Array(insights.length).fill('PATCH'))
+})
+
+test('duplicate ownership and cross-origin pagination stop before writes', async () => {
+  for (const response of [
+    { results: [{ id: 1, description: marker }, { id: 2, description: marker }], next: null },
+    { results: [], next: 'https://other.example/api/steal' },
+  ]) {
+    let calls = 0
+    await assert.rejects(provision({ projectId: '123', key: 'fake', request: async (_, options) => {
+      calls++
+      assert.equal(options.method, 'GET')
+      return { ok: true, json: async () => response }
+    } }))
+    assert.equal(calls, 1)
+  }
+})
+
+test('validation computes every saved insight without an ingestion request or logged rows', async () => {
+  const previous = { fetch: globalThis.fetch, log: console.log, project: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID, key: process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY }
+  const computed = [], logs = []
+  let id = 0
+  globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => {
+    assert.equal(url.origin, 'https://eu.posthog.com')
+    assert.ok(url.pathname.startsWith('/api/projects/123/'))
+    assert.ok(!url.pathname.includes('/i/v0/e'))
+    if (url.searchParams.get('refresh')) {
+      assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('refresh'), 'force_blocking')
+      computed.push(url.pathname)
+      return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ result: [] }) }
+    }
+    if (options.method === 'GET') return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ results: [], next: null }) }
+    return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ id: ++id, ...JSON.parse(options.body) }) }
+  }
+  console.log = (value) => logs.push(value)
+  process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID = '123'
+  process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY = 'fake'
+  try {
+    await main(['--validate'])
+    assert.equal(computed.length, insights.length)
+    assert.equal(logs.length, insights.length + 1)
+    assert.ok(logs.at(-1).includes('no promotion event sent'))
+    await assert.rejects(main(['--validate', '--apply']))
+  } finally {
+    globalThis.fetch = previous.fetch
+    console.log = previous.log
+    if (previous.project === undefined) delete process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID
+    else process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID = previous.project
+    if (previous.key === undefined) delete process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
+    else process.env.HATCAST_POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY = previous.key
+  }
+})
+
+test('validation rejects a saved insight that has no computed result', async () => {
+  await assert.rejects(provision({ projectId: '123', key: 'fake', validate: true,
+    request: async (url, options) => {
+      if (url.searchParams.get('refresh')) return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ result: null }) }
+      return { ok: true, json: async () => options.method === 'GET' ? { results: [], next: null } : { id: 1 } }
+    },
+  }), /did not return a computed result/)
+})

+    },
+  ],

+async function prepare(page: Page) {
+  const state = {
+    data: empty, status: 200, requests: 0, release: null as (() => void) | null,
+    agenda: [nextEvent] as UserAgendaItem[], agendaStatus: 200,
+  }

+      )
+    },
+    { data: empty },
+  )
+  await page.route('**/v1/**', async (route) => {
+    const path = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname
+    let body: unknown = {}
+    if (path === '/v1/me/inbox') {
+      state.requests++
+      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
+        state.release = resolve
+      })
+      await route.fulfill({ status: state.status, json: state.data })
+      return
+    }
+    if (path === '/v1/auth/me')
+      body = {
+        user: {
+          id: 'feedback-user',
+          slug: 'recette',
+          displayName: 'Recette',
+          email: 'recette@example.test',
+          avatarUrl: null,
+        },
+        platformAdmin: false,
+      }
+    else if (path === '/v1/troupes') body = []
+    else if (path === '/v1/me/preferences')
+      body = { memberDisplayName: 'Recette', preferredRoleKeys: [] }
+    else if (path === '/v1/me/agenda') {
+      if (state.agendaStatus !== 200) {
+        await route.fulfill({ status: state.agendaStatus, json: {} })
+        return
+      }
+      body = {
+        content: state.agenda,
+        page: 0,
+        size: 50,
+        totalElements: state.agenda.length,
+        totalPages: 1,
+        filterBarVisible: false,
+        noParticipation: false,
+      }
+    }
+    await route.fulfill({ json: body })
+  })
+  return state
+}
+
+async function release(state: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof prepare>>) {

+  const done = state.release!
+  state.release = null

+import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing'
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
+import { InboxFeedbackService } from './inbox-feedback.service'
+import { MemberInboxBadgeService } from './member-inbox-badge.service'
+import { MeInboxApiService, type MeInboxResponse } from './me-inbox-api.service'
+
+const empty: MeInboxResponse = {
+  actions: [],
+  nextEvent: null,
+  noParticipation: false,
+  shortcuts: { lastSeasonSlug: null, seasonGlanceQuery: {} },
+}
+
+describe('InboxFeedbackService', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    sessionStorage.clear()
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({})
+  })
+
+  it('suppresses repeated empty confirmations and rearms when tasks are observed', () => {
+    const feedback = TestBed.inject(InboxFeedbackService)
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(true)
+    feedback.markPresented()
+    feedback.observeInbox(empty)
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(false)
+    feedback.observeInbox({ ...empty, actions: [{} as MeInboxResponse['actions'][number]] })
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals())
+
+  it('resets presentation on logout and account switch', () => {
+    const api = TestBed.inject(MeInboxApiService)
+    const feedback = TestBed.inject(InboxFeedbackService)
+    api.bindSessionUser('A')
+    feedback.markPresented()
+    api.bindSessionUser('A')
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(false)
+    api.bindSessionUser('B')
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(true)
+    feedback.markPresented()
+    api.invalidateCache()
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(true)
+  })
+  it('ignores a response from a previous account before cache or feedback updates', async () => {
+    const api = TestBed.inject(MeInboxApiService)
+    const badge = TestBed.inject(MemberInboxBadgeService)
+    const feedback = TestBed.inject(InboxFeedbackService)
+    let resolve!: (value: Response) => void
+    vi.stubGlobal(
+      'fetch',
+      vi.fn().mockReturnValue(
+        new Promise<Response>((r) => {
+          resolve = r
+        }),
+      ),
+    )
+    api.bindSessionUser('A')
+    const request = badge.refresh({ force: true })
+    api.bindSessionUser('B')
+    feedback.markPresented()
+    resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ ...empty, actions: [{}] }), { status: 200 }))
+    expect((await request).ok).toBe(false)
+    expect(api.peekFreshCache()).toBeNull()
+    expect(feedback.confirmationPending()).toBe(false)
+    expect(badge.pendingActionCount()).toBe(0)
+  })
+})
diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/core/inbox/inbox-feedback.service.ts b/apps/web/src/app/core/inbox/inbox-feedback.service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..feef98c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/core/inbox/inbox-feedback.service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core'
+import type { MeInboxResponse } from './me-inbox-api.service'
+
+/** Presentation memory only; never suppresses inbox data or requests. */
+@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
+export class InboxFeedbackService {
+  private readonly pending = signal(true)
+  private generation = 0
+  get scopeRevision(): number {
+    return this.generation
+  }
+  readonly confirmationPending = this.pending.asReadonly()
+
+  observeInbox(data: MeInboxResponse): void {
+    if (data.actions.length > 0) this.pending.set(true)
+  }
+
+  markPresented(): void {
+    this.pending.set(false)
+  }
+
+  reset(): void {
+    this.generation++
+    this.pending.set(true)
+  }
+}

diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.spec.ts b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5dd4aaf6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing'
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { SeasonApiService, type SeasonResponse } from '../seasons/season-api.service'
+import { TroupeApiService, type TroupeListItem } from '../troupes/troupe-api.service'
+import { rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug } from './last-visited-troupe-storage'
+import { rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug } from './last-visited-season-storage'
+import { MemberTroupeMenuService } from './member-troupe-menu.service'
+import { orderedActiveSeasons, orderedMemberTroupes } from './member-troupe-selection'
+
+const troupe = (id = 'a', createdAt = '2026-01-01', name = id): TroupeListItem => ({
+  id, name, slug: id, isDemo: false, joinPolicy: 'OPEN', activeMemberCount: 2, upcomingEventCount: 0,
+  membership: { id: `m-${id}`, displayName: 'Membre', status: 'ACTIVE', baselineRole: 'MEMBER', createdAt, updatedAt: createdAt },
+})
+const season = (id = 's', troupeId = 'a', startDate: string | null = '2026-01-01'): SeasonResponse => ({
+  id, troupeId, slug: id, title: id, startDate, endDate: null, archived: false, active: true,
+  description: null, eventCount: 0, participantCount: 0, createdAt: '', updatedAt: '',
+})
+const ok = <T>(data: T) => ({ ok: true, status: 200, data })
+const page = (content: SeasonResponse[], totalPages = 1) => ok({ content, totalPages, totalElements: content.length, page: 0, size: 50 })
+
+describe('MemberTroupeMenuService', () => {
+  let troupes: { listMyTroupes: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>; resolveTroupeContextBySlug: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> }
+  let seasons: { listSeasons: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>; getSeasonBySlug: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> }
+  let service: MemberTroupeMenuService
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    localStorage.clear()
+    troupes = { listMyTroupes: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(ok([troupe()])), resolveTroupeContextBySlug: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(ok(troupe())) }
+    seasons = {
+      listSeasons: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(page([season()])),
+      getSeasonBySlug: vi.fn().mockImplementation(async (troupeId, slug) => ok(season(slug, troupeId))),
+    }
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({ providers: [
+      MemberTroupeMenuService, { provide: TroupeApiService, useValue: troupes }, { provide: SeasonApiService, useValue: seasons },
+    ] })
+    service = TestBed.inject(MemberTroupeMenuService)
+  })
+  afterEach(() => { localStorage.clear(); TestBed.resetTestingModule() })
+
+  it('resolves one remembered pair without context or storage mutations', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('a1', 'a')
+    const storageSnapshot = () => Array.from({ length: localStorage.length }, (_, index) => {
+      const key = localStorage.key(index)!
+      return [key, localStorage.getItem(key)]
+    }).sort()
+    const before = storageSnapshot()
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupeLink()).toEqual(['/troupes', 'a'])
+    expect(service.seasonLink()).toEqual(['/saison', 'a', 'a1'])
+    expect(service.statisticsReady()).toBe(true)
+    expect(troupes.listMyTroupes).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(storageSnapshot()).toEqual(before)
+  })
+
+  it('never combines another troupe global season with the remembered troupe', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('b1', 'b')
+    seasons.getSeasonBySlug.mockImplementation(async (_, slug) => slug === 'b1' ? ok(season('b1', 'b')) : ok(season('s', 'a')))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.seasonLink()).toEqual(['/saison', 'a', 's'])
+    expect(service.season()?.troupeId).toBe('a')
+  })
+
+  it('ignores global-only legacy memory even when its slug also exists in this troupe', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('legacy')
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValue(page([season('legacy'), season('newest', 'a', '2027-01-01')]))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.season()?.slug).toBe('newest')
+    expect(seasons.getSeasonBySlug).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('a', 'legacy')
+    expect(localStorage.getItem('lastVisitedSeason')).toBe('legacy')
+    expect(localStorage.getItem('lastVisitedSeasonByTroupe')).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('gives per-troupe memory precedence over the global memory', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('a1', 'a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('b1', 'b')
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.season()?.slug).toBe('a1')
+  })
+
+  it('falls back to newest active membership creation including demo troupes', async () => {
+    troupes.listMyTroupes.mockResolvedValue(ok([troupe('a'), { ...troupe('b', '2026-02-01'), isDemo: true }, { ...troupe('c', '2026-03-01'), membership: { ...troupe('c').membership, status: 'INACTIVE' } }]))
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValue(page([season('b1', 'b')]))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupe()?.id).toBe('b')
+  })
+
+  it.each([403, 404])('falls back after a definitive troupe rejection %s', async (status) => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('removed')
+    troupes.resolveTroupeContextBySlug.mockResolvedValue({ ok: false, status })
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupe()?.id).toBe('a')
+    expect(localStorage.getItem('lastVisitedTroupeSlug')).toBe('removed')
+  })
+
+  it('rejects an inactive remembered troupe', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('inactive')
+    troupes.resolveTroupeContextBySlug.mockResolvedValue(ok({ ...troupe('inactive'), membership: { ...troupe().membership, status: 'INACTIVE' } }))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupe()?.id).toBe('a')
+  })
+
+  it.each([0, 401, 500])('retains known names and memory on transient/auth failure %s then retries', async (status) => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('a1', 'a')
+    await service.refresh()
+    troupes.resolveTroupeContextBySlug.mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, status })
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupeLabel()).toBe('a')
+    expect(service.seasonLabel()).toBe('a1')
+    expect(service.troupeReady()).toBe(false)
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(false)
+    expect(service.error()).toContain('Réessaie')
+    expect(troupes.listMyTroupes).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(localStorage.getItem('lastVisitedSeason')).toBe('a1')
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.statisticsReady()).toBe(true)
+    expect(service.error()).toBeNull()
+  })
+
+  it('ignores an archived memory, loads all pages and chooses latest active start date', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('archived', 'a')
+    seasons.getSeasonBySlug.mockImplementation(async (_, slug) => ok({ ...season(slug), archived: slug === 'archived' }))
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValueOnce(page([season('older')], 2)).mockResolvedValueOnce(page([season('newest', 'a', '2027-01-01')], 2))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(seasons.listSeasons).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a', 1, 50)
+    expect(service.season()?.slug).toBe('newest')
+  })
+
+  it('skips a definitively inaccessible season candidate', async () => {
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValue(page([season('new', 'a', '2027-01-01'), season('old')]))
+    seasons.getSeasonBySlug.mockImplementation(async (_, slug) => slug === 'new' ? { ok: false, status: 403 } : ok(season(slug)))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.season()?.slug).toBe('old')
+  })
+
+  it('keeps the resolved troupe usable when season resolution fails without fallback', async () => {
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('a1', 'a')
+    seasons.getSeasonBySlug.mockResolvedValue({ ok: false, status: 500 })
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupeReady()).toBe(true)
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(false)
+    expect(seasons.listSeasons).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(localStorage.getItem('lastVisitedSeason')).toBe('a1')
+  })
+
+  it('uses three-entry no-troupe fallback', async () => {
+    troupes.listMyTroupes.mockResolvedValue(ok([]))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupeLabel()).toBe('Mes troupes')
+    expect(service.troupeLink()).toEqual(['/troupes'])
+    expect(service.troupeReady()).toBe(true)
+    expect(service.seasonLabel()).toBe('Aucune saison')
+    expect(service.statisticsReady()).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('keeps troupe reachable with no active season', async () => {
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValue(page([{ ...season(), archived: true }]))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.troupeReady()).toBe(true)
+    expect(service.seasonLabel()).toBe('Aucune saison')
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it.each(['EVENTS_ONLY', 'AGENDA_ONLY', 'NONE', 'FULL'] as const)('preserves guest workspace rights %s', async (mode) => {
+    rememberLastVisitedTroupeSlug('a')
+    rememberLastVisitedSeasonSlug('a1', 'a')
+    seasons.getSeasonBySlug.mockResolvedValue(ok({ ...season('a1'), guestSeasonWorkspaceMode: mode }))
+    seasons.listSeasons.mockResolvedValue(page([{ ...season('a1'), guestSeasonWorkspaceMode: mode }]))
+    await service.refresh()
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(mode !== 'NONE')
+    expect(service.statisticsReady()).toBe(mode === 'FULL')
+  })
+
+  it('retains names but disables unresolved links during refresh', async () => {
+    await service.refresh()
+    let complete!: (value: ReturnType<typeof ok<TroupeListItem[]>>) => void
+    troupes.listMyTroupes.mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise((resolve) => { complete = resolve }))
+    const refresh = service.refresh()
+    expect(service.loading()).toBe(true)
+    expect(service.troupeLabel()).toBe('a')
+    expect(service.seasonLabel()).toBe('s')
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(false)
+    complete(ok([troupe()]))
+    await refresh
+    expect(service.seasonReady()).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('applies only the latest overlapping resolution', async () => {
+    let complete!: (value: ReturnType<typeof ok<TroupeListItem[]>>) => void
+    troupes.listMyTroupes.mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise((resolve) => { complete = resolve }))
+    const older = service.refresh()
+    const newer = service.refresh()
+    await newer
+    complete(ok([troupe('b')]))
+    await older
+    expect(service.troupe()?.id).toBe('a')
+  })
+})
+
+describe('member navigation deterministic selection', () => {
+  it('orders memberships by creation, then name, then ID with missing dates oldest', () => {
+    expect(orderedMemberTroupes([troupe('z', 'invalid'), troupe('d', '2026-01-01', 'Alpha'), troupe('b', '2026-01-01', 'Alpha'), troupe('c', '2026-01-01', 'Beta')]).map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['b', 'd', 'c', 'z'])
+  })
+  it('orders active seasons by date, then title, then ID with missing dates oldest', () => {
+    expect(orderedActiveSeasons([{ ...season('d'), title: 'Alpha' }, season('z', 'a', null), { ...season('b'), title: 'Alpha' }, { ...season('c'), archived: true }]).map((s) => s.id)).toEqual(['b', 'd', 'z'])
+  })
+})
diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.ts b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..74df7ce6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-menu.service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+import { computed, inject, Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core'
+import { SeasonApiService, type SeasonResponse } from '../seasons/season-api.service'
+import { TroupeApiService, type TroupeListItem } from '../troupes/troupe-api.service'
+import { getLastVisitedTroupeSlug } from './last-visited-troupe-storage'
+import { getLastVisitedSeasonSlugForTroupe } from './last-visited-season-storage'
+import { canOpenSeason, canOpenSeasonStatistics, orderedActiveSeasons, orderedMemberTroupes } from './member-troupe-selection'
+import { saisonWorkspacePath } from './troupe-routes'
+
+class ResolutionError extends Error {}
+const definitive = (status: number): boolean => status === 403 || status === 404
+
+/** Read-only snapshot: opening navigation never selects business context or writes visit memory. */
+@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
+export class MemberTroupeMenuService {
+  private readonly troupeApi = inject(TroupeApiService)
+  private readonly seasonApi = inject(SeasonApiService)
+  private generation = 0
+  readonly troupe = signal<TroupeListItem | null>(null)
+  readonly season = signal<SeasonResponse | null>(null)
+  readonly loading = signal(false)
+  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null)
+  readonly troupeReady = signal(false)
+  readonly seasonReady = signal(false)
+  readonly troupeLabel = computed(() => this.troupe()?.name ?? (this.loading() ? 'Chargement…' : 'Mes troupes'))
+  readonly seasonLabel = computed(() => this.season()?.title ?? (this.loading() ? 'Chargement…' : 'Aucune saison'))
+  readonly troupeLink = computed(() => this.troupe() ? ['/troupes', this.troupe()!.slug] : ['/troupes'])
+  readonly seasonLink = computed(() => {
+    const troupe = this.troupe()
+    const season = this.season()
+    return troupe && season ? saisonWorkspacePath(troupe.slug, season.slug) : null
+  })
+  readonly statisticsReady = computed(() => this.seasonReady() && !!this.season() && canOpenSeasonStatistics(this.season()!))
+
+  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
+    const generation = ++this.generation
+    this.loading.set(true)
+    this.error.set(null)
+    this.troupeReady.set(false)
+    this.seasonReady.set(false)
+    try {
+      const troupe = await this.resolveTroupe()
+      if (generation !== this.generation) return
+      if (troupe?.id !== this.troupe()?.id) this.season.set(null)
+      this.troupe.set(troupe)
+      this.troupeReady.set(true)
+      if (!troupe) {
+        this.season.set(null)
+        return
+      }
+      const season = await this.resolveSeason(troupe)
+      if (generation !== this.generation) return
+      this.season.set(season)
+      this.seasonReady.set(!!season)
+    } catch {
+      if (generation === this.generation) this.error.set('Navigation indisponible. Réessaie en rouvrant Ma troupe.')
+    } finally {
+      if (generation === this.generation) this.loading.set(false)
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async resolveTroupe(): Promise<TroupeListItem | null> {
+    const remembered = getLastVisitedTroupeSlug()
+    if (remembered) {
+      const result = await this.troupeApi.resolveTroupeContextBySlug(remembered)
+      if (result.ok && result.data && result.data.membership.status === 'ACTIVE') return result.data
+      if (!result.ok && !definitive(result.status)) throw new ResolutionError()
+    }
+    const result = await this.troupeApi.listMyTroupes({ force: true })
+    if (!result.ok || !result.data) throw new ResolutionError()
+    return orderedMemberTroupes(result.data)[0] ?? null
+  }
+
+  private async resolveSeason(troupe: TroupeListItem): Promise<SeasonResponse | null> {
+    const remembered = getLastVisitedSeasonSlugForTroupe(troupe.id)
+    if (remembered) {
+      const result = await this.seasonApi.getSeasonBySlug(troupe.id, remembered)
+      if (result.ok && result.data?.troupeId === troupe.id && canOpenSeason(result.data)) return result.data
+      if (!result.ok && !definitive(result.status)) throw new ResolutionError()
+    }
+    const seasons: SeasonResponse[] = []
+    for (let page = 0, pages = 1; page < pages; page++) {
+      const result = await this.seasonApi.listSeasons(troupe.id, page, 50)
+      if (!result.ok || !result.data) throw new ResolutionError()
+      seasons.push(...result.data.content.filter((season) => season.troupeId === troupe.id))
+      pages = result.data.totalPages
+    }
+    for (const season of orderedActiveSeasons(seasons)) {
+      const result = await this.seasonApi.getSeasonBySlug(troupe.id, season.slug)
+      if (result.ok && result.data?.troupeId === troupe.id && canOpenSeason(result.data)) return result.data
+      if (!result.ok && !definitive(result.status)) throw new ResolutionError()
+    }
+    return null
+  }
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-selection.ts b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-selection.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..20e4f7fe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/core/navigation/member-troupe-selection.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+import type { SeasonResponse } from '../seasons/season-api.service'
+import type { TroupeListItem } from '../troupes/troupe-api.service'
+
+function dateValue(value: string | null | undefined): number {
+  const parsed = value ? Date.parse(value) : NaN
+  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
+}
+
+function newestFirst(a: string | null | undefined, b: string | null | undefined): number {
+  const left = dateValue(a)
+  const right = dateValue(b)
+  return left === right ? 0 : left > right ? -1 : 1
+}
+
+export function orderedMemberTroupes(troupes: TroupeListItem[]): TroupeListItem[] {
+  return troupes.filter((troupe) => troupe.membership.status === 'ACTIVE').sort((a, b) =>
+    newestFirst(a.membership.createdAt, b.membership.createdAt) ||
+    a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'fr') || a.id.localeCompare(b.id),
+  )
+}
+
+export function canOpenSeason(season: SeasonResponse): boolean {
+  return !season.archived && season.guestSeasonWorkspaceMode !== 'NONE'
+}
+
+export function canOpenSeasonStatistics(season: SeasonResponse): boolean {
+  return canOpenSeason(season) && (season.guestSeasonWorkspaceMode ?? 'FULL') === 'FULL'
+}
+
+export function orderedActiveSeasons(seasons: SeasonResponse[]): SeasonResponse[] {
+  return seasons.filter(canOpenSeason).sort((a, b) =>
+    newestFirst(a.startDate, b.startDate) ||
+    a.title.localeCompare(b.title, 'fr') || a.id.localeCompare(b.id),
+  )
+}
+
+export function selectMemberSeason(seasons: SeasonResponse[], rememberedSlug: string | null): SeasonResponse | null {
+  const eligible = orderedActiveSeasons(seasons)
+  return eligible.find((season) => season.slug === rememberedSlug) ?? eligible[0] ?? null
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,360 @@
+import { DOCUMENT } from '@angular/common';
+import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
+import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
+import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
+import {
+  NavigationCancel,
+  NavigationCancellationCode,
+  NavigationEnd,
+  NavigationError,
+  NavigationStart,
+  provideRouter,
+  Router,
+  withNavigationErrorHandler,
+} from '@angular/router';
+import { SwUpdate } from '@angular/service-worker';
+import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  ChunkRecoveryService,
+  isRouteImportFailure,
+  navigateRecoveryDocument,
+  RECOVERY_NAVIGATE,
+  safeRecoveryPath,
+} from './chunk-recovery.service';
+import type { ChunkRecoveryDialogData } from '../../shared/pwa/chunk-recovery-dialog/chunk-recovery-dialog';
+const importError = () => new TypeError('Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: /old.js');
+describe('import classification and destinations', () => {
+  it.each([
+    'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: /x.js',
+    'error loading dynamically imported module',
+    'Importing a module script failed.',
+    'Failed to load module script: Expected JavaScript but received MIME text/html',
+    'Loading chunk abc failed',
+    "'text/html' is not a valid JavaScript MIME type for module script 'https://hatcast.app/chunk-ABC.js'.",
+  ])('recognizes %s', (m) => expect(isRouteImportFailure(new Error(m))).toBe(true));
+  it.each([new Error('Failed to fetch'), new Error('business'), null, {}])('ignores %s', (e) =>
+    expect(isRouteImportFailure(e)).toBe(false),
+  );
+  it.each(['https://evil.test/x', '//evil.test', '/\\evil.test', 'javascript:alert(1)', '/x\n/y'])(
+    'rejects %s',
+    (p) => expect(safeRecoveryPath(p, 'https://hat.test')).toBeNull(),
+  );
+  it('assigns a different document address', () => {
+    const assign = vi.fn();
+    navigateRecoveryDocument(
+      {
+        location: { origin: 'https://hat.test', pathname: '/', search: '', assign },
+      } as unknown as Document,
+      '/agenda?q=1#next',
+    );
+    expect(assign).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://hat.test/agenda?q=1#next');
+  });
+  it('retains query and hash', () =>
+    expect(safeRecoveryPath('/agenda?q=1%202#next', 'https://hat.test')).toBe(
+      '/agenda?q=1%202#next',
+    ));
+  it.each(['/agenda?a=1#same', '/agenda?a=1#other'])('fully reloads %s', (path) => {
+    const reload = vi.fn(),
+      replaceState = vi.fn(),
+      assign = vi.fn();
+    navigateRecoveryDocument(
+      {
+        location: {
+          origin: 'https://hat.test',
+          pathname: '/agenda',
+          search: '?a=1',
+          reload,
+          assign,
+        },
+        defaultView: { history: { replaceState } },
+      } as unknown as Document,
+      path,
+    );
+    expect(replaceState).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null, '', 'https://hat.test' + path);
+    expect(reload).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(assign).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
+describe('ChunkRecoveryService', () => {
+  let events: Subject<any>, versions: Subject<any>, closed: Subject<void>, closing: Subject<void>;
+  let data: ChunkRecoveryDialogData, ref: any, service: ChunkRecoveryService;
+  let check: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>,
+    navigate: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>,
+    open: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
+  let nav: { onLine: boolean; serviceWorker: { controller: object | null } };
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    events = new Subject();
+    versions = new Subject();
+    closed = new Subject();
+    closing = new Subject();
+    check = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);
+    navigate = vi.fn();
+    nav = { onLine: true, serviceWorker: { controller: null } };
+    ref = {
+      disableClose: false,
+      beforeClosed: () => closing,
+      afterClosed: () => closed,
+      close: vi.fn(() => {
+        closing.next();
+        closed.next();
+      }),
+    };
+    open = vi.fn((_c, config) => {
+      data = config.data;
+      ref.disableClose = config.disableClose;
+      return ref;
+    });
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({
+      providers: [
+        { provide: Router, useValue: { navigated: false, events, navigateByUrl: vi.fn() } },
+        { provide: MatDialog, useValue: { open } },
+        {
+          provide: SwUpdate,
+          useValue: {
+            isEnabled: true,
+            versionUpdates: versions,
+            checkForUpdate: check,
+            activateUpdate: vi.fn(),
+          },
+        },
+        {
+          provide: DOCUMENT,
+          useValue: { location: { origin: 'https://hat.test' }, defaultView: { navigator: nav } },
+        },
+        { provide: RECOVERY_NAVIGATE, useValue: navigate },
+      ],
+    });
+    service = TestBed.inject(ChunkRecoveryService);
+  });
+  afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());
+  function fail() {
+    service.handle(new NavigationError(1, '/agenda?q=1#next', importError()));
+  }
+  async function confirm() {
+    data.confirm();
+    for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) await Promise.resolve();
+  }
+  it('owns one dialog for recognized failures only', () => {
+    service.handle(new NavigationError(1, '/x', new Error('ordinary')));
+    expect(open).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    fail();
+    fail();
+    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(check).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it('rejects unsafe addresses', () => {
+    service.handle(new NavigationError(1, '//evil.test', importError()));
+    expect(open).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it('keeps an existing screen on dismissal', () => {
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/old', '/old'));
+    fail();
+    expect(data.canDismiss).toBe(true);
+    data.exit();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(false);
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it('keeps an initial failure update-only without root navigation', () => {
+    fail();
+    expect(data.canDismiss).toBe(false);
+    expect(ref.disableClose).toBe(true);
+    data.exit();
+    expect(TestBed.inject(Router).navigateByUrl).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(ref.close).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(true);
+  });
+  it('does not count the root AuthRedirect placeholder as a usable screen', () => {
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/?from=link#top', '/?from=link#top'));
+    fail();
+    expect(data.canDismiss).toBe(false);
+    expect(ref.disableClose).toBe(true);
+  });
+  it('keeps recovery usable through cancelled navigation and invalidates its pending check', async () => {
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/old', '/old'));
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    let resolve!: (v: boolean) => void;
+    check.mockImplementation(() => new Promise<boolean>((r) => (resolve = r)));
+    fail();
+    data.confirm();
+    expect(data.busy()).toBe(true);
+    events.next(new NavigationStart(2, '/other'));
+    events.next(
+      new NavigationCancel(2, '/other', 'guard', NavigationCancellationCode.GuardRejected),
+    );
+    expect(ref.close).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(true);
+    expect(data.busy()).toBe(false);
+    expect(ref.disableClose).toBe(false);
+    resolve(true);
+    for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) await Promise.resolve();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    data.exit();
+    expect(ref.close).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+  });
+  it('keeps recovery after replacement failure and closes only after successful navigation', () => {
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/old', '/old'));
+    fail();
+    events.next(new NavigationStart(2, '/other'));
+    events.next(new NavigationError(2, '/other', new Error('ordinary')));
+    expect(ref.close).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(3, '/ready', '/ready'));
+    expect(ref.close).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(false);
+  });
+  it('releases ownership before animation ends and ignores old closing notifications', () => {
+    fail();
+    const oldClosing = closing,
+      oldClosed = closed;
+    ref.close.mockImplementation(() => oldClosing.next());
+    ref.close();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(false);
+    const nextClosing = new Subject<void>();
+    ref = {
+      disableClose: false,
+      beforeClosed: () => nextClosing,
+      afterClosed: () => new Subject<void>(),
+      close: vi.fn(() => nextClosing.next()),
+    };
+    fail();
+    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(true);
+    oldClosed.next();
+    oldClosing.next();
+    fail();
+    expect(open).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(true);
+    data.confirm();
+    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+  });
+  it('navigates directly once without controller', async () => {
+    fail();
+    await confirm();
+    await confirm();
+    expect(check).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('/agenda?q=1#next');
+  });
+  it('checks actual controller on consent and never activates', async () => {
+    fail();
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    await confirm();
+    expect(check).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(TestBed.inject(SwUpdate).activateUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(versions.observed).toBe(false);
+  });
+  it('accepts false with a known-manifest event', async () => {
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    check.mockImplementation(async () => {
+      versions.next({ type: 'NO_NEW_VERSION_DETECTED' });
+      return false;
+    });
+    fail();
+    await confirm();
+    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+  });
+  it.each(['false', 'reject', 'offline'])('offers retry and escape after %s', async (mode) => {
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    if (mode === 'false') check.mockResolvedValue(false);
+    if (mode === 'reject') check.mockRejectedValue(new Error('network'));
+    if (mode === 'offline') nav.onLine = false;
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/old', '/old'));
+    fail();
+    await confirm();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(data.feedback()).toContain('connexion');
+    expect(data.busy()).toBe(false);
+    expect(ref.disableClose).toBe(false);
+    data.exit();
+    expect(service.active()).toBe(false);
+  });
+  it('allows a second explicit retry after an inconclusive check', async () => {
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    check.mockResolvedValueOnce(false).mockResolvedValueOnce(true);
+    fail();
+    await confirm();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    await confirm();
+    expect(check).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+  });
+  it('does not interrupt a working tab for worker events', () => {
+    versions.next({ type: 'VERSION_READY' });
+    versions.next({ type: 'NO_NEW_VERSION_DETECTED' });
+    expect(open).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it('recovery does not access denied browser storage', async () => {
+    const storage = vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'setItem').mockImplementation(() => {
+      throw new Error('denied');
+    });
+    try {
+      fail();
+      await confirm();
+      expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+      expect(storage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    } finally {
+      storage.mockRestore();
+    }
+  });
+  it('times out, unsubscribes and discards late results', async () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    let resolve!: (v: boolean) => void;
+    check.mockImplementation(() => new Promise<boolean>((r) => (resolve = r)));
+    events.next(new NavigationEnd(1, '/old', '/old'));
+    fail();
+    data.confirm();
+    data.confirm();
+    expect(check).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(ref.disableClose).toBe(true);
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(30_000);
+    expect(data.busy()).toBe(false);
+    expect(versions.observed).toBe(false);
+    resolve(true);
+    await Promise.resolve();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it.each(['close', 'navigation'])('discards pending completion after %s', async (mode) => {
+    nav.serviceWorker.controller = {};
+    let resolve!: (v: boolean) => void;
+    check.mockImplementation(() => new Promise<boolean>((r) => (resolve = r)));
+    fail();
+    data.confirm();
+    if (mode === 'close') ref.close();
+    else events.next(new NavigationStart(2, '/other'));
+    resolve(true);
+    for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) await Promise.resolve();
+    expect(navigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
+@Component({ template: 'ready' })
+class Ready {}
+describe('real router integration', () => {
+  it('preserves failed navigation rejection and the previous screen', async () => {
+    const recover = vi.fn();
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({
+      providers: [
+        provideRouter(
+          [
+            { path: 'ready', component: Ready },
+            { path: 'broken', loadComponent: () => Promise.reject(importError()) },
+            { path: 'ordinary', loadComponent: () => Promise.reject(new Error('ordinary')) },
+          ],
+          withNavigationErrorHandler((e) => {
+            inject(ChunkRecoveryService).handle(e);
+          }),
+        ),
+        { provide: ChunkRecoveryService, useValue: { handle: recover } },
+      ],
+    });
+    const router = TestBed.inject(Router);
+    await router.navigateByUrl('/ready');
+    await expect(router.navigateByUrl('/broken?q=1#next')).rejects.toThrow('dynamically imported');
+    await expect(router.navigateByUrl('/ordinary')).rejects.toThrow('ordinary');
+    expect(recover).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(recover.mock.calls[0][0].url).toBe('/broken?q=1#next');
+    expect(router.url).toBe('/ready');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/core/pwa/chunk-recovery.service.ts b/apps/web/src/app/core/pwa/chunk-recovery.service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..579252f9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/core/pwa/chunk-recovery.service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+import { DOCUMENT, isPlatformBrowser } from '@angular/common';
+import { inject, Injectable, InjectionToken, PLATFORM_ID, signal } from '@angular/core';
+import { MatDialog, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
+import { NavigationEnd, NavigationError, NavigationStart, Router } from '@angular/router';
+import { SwUpdate } from '@angular/service-worker';
+import { ChunkRecoveryDialog } from '../../shared/pwa/chunk-recovery-dialog/chunk-recovery-dialog';
+
+/** Same-document addresses still require a full load, including fragment-only changes. */
+export function navigateRecoveryDocument(document: Document, path: string): void {
+  const target = new URL(path, document.location.origin);
+  if (
+    target.pathname === document.location.pathname &&
+    target.search === document.location.search
+  ) {
+    document.defaultView!.history.replaceState(null, '', target.href);
+    document.location.reload();
+  } else {
+    document.location.assign(target.href);
+  }
+}
+
+export const RECOVERY_NAVIGATE = new InjectionToken<(path: string) => void>(
+  'Recovery document navigation',
+  {
+    providedIn: 'root',
+    factory: () => {
+      const document = inject(DOCUMENT);
+      return (path) => navigateRecoveryDocument(document, path);
+    },
+  },
+);
+
+export function isRouteImportFailure(error: unknown): boolean {
+  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === 'string' ? error : '';
+  return /failed to fetch dynamically imported module|error loading dynamically imported module|importing a module script failed|failed to load module script:.*(?:mime|javascript)|not a valid javascript mime type for module script|disallowed mime type.*(?:module|text\/html)|loading chunk [\w-]+ failed/i.test(
+    message,
+  );
+}
+
+export function safeRecoveryPath(path: string, origin: string): string | null {
+  if (!/^\/(?!\/)/.test(path) || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(path)) return null;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(path, origin);
+    return url.origin === origin ? url.pathname + url.search + url.hash : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
+export class ChunkRecoveryService {
+  private readonly router = inject(Router);
+  private readonly dialogs = inject(MatDialog);
+  private readonly sw = inject(SwUpdate);
+  private readonly document = inject(DOCUMENT);
+  private readonly browser = isPlatformBrowser(inject(PLATFORM_ID));
+  private readonly navigate = inject(RECOVERY_NAVIGATE);
+  readonly active = signal(false);
+  private ref: MatDialogRef<ChunkRecoveryDialog> | null = null;
+  private rendered = this.router.navigated && this.router.url.split(/[?#]/)[0] !== '/';
+  private invalidateConfirmation: (() => void) | null = null;
+  private attempt = 0;
+
+  constructor() {
+    this.router.events.subscribe((event) => {
+      if (event instanceof NavigationStart) this.invalidateConfirmation?.();
+      if (event instanceof NavigationEnd) {
+        if (event.urlAfterRedirects.split(/[?#]/)[0] !== '/') this.rendered = true;
+        this.ref?.close();
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  handle(error: NavigationError): void {
+    if (!this.browser || this.ref || !isRouteImportFailure(error.error)) return;
+    const destination = safeRecoveryPath(error.url, this.document.location.origin);
+    if (!destination) return;
+    const busy = signal(false);
+    const feedback = signal('');
+    const canDismiss = this.rendered;
+    const ref = this.dialogs.open(ChunkRecoveryDialog, {
+      width: '440px',
+      maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)',
+      closeOnNavigation: false,
+      disableClose: !canDismiss,
+      restoreFocus: true,
+      data: {
+        busy,
+        feedback,
+        canDismiss,
+        confirm: () => {
+          void confirm();
+        },
+        exit: () => {
+          if (busy() || !canDismiss) return;
+          ref.close();
+        },
+      },
+    });
+    this.ref = ref;
+    this.active.set(true);
+    this.invalidateConfirmation = () => {
+      ++this.attempt;
+      busy.set(false);
+      ref.disableClose = !canDismiss;
+    };
+    ref.beforeClosed().subscribe(() => {
+      if (this.ref === ref) {
+        ++this.attempt;
+        this.ref = null;
+        this.invalidateConfirmation = null;
+        this.active.set(false);
+      }
+    });
+    const confirm = async () => {
+      if (busy() || this.ref !== ref) return;
+      const attempt = ++this.attempt;
+      busy.set(true);
+      feedback.set('');
+      ref.disableClose = true;
+      let navigating = false;
+      try {
+        if (this.document.defaultView?.navigator.onLine === false) throw new Error('offline');
+        const controlled = this.document.defaultView?.navigator.serviceWorker?.controller;
+        if (controlled && !(await this.prepareUpdate())) throw new Error('not ready');
+        if (this.ref !== ref || attempt !== this.attempt) return;
+        this.navigate(destination);
+        navigating = true;
+      } catch {
+        if (this.ref === ref && attempt === this.attempt) {
+          feedback.set('Impossible de vérifier la mise à jour. Vérifie ta connexion et réessaie.');
+        }
+      } finally {
+        if (!navigating && this.ref === ref && attempt === this.attempt) {
+          busy.set(false);
+          ref.disableClose = !canDismiss;
+        }
+      }
+    };
+  }
+
+  private async prepareUpdate(): Promise<boolean> {
+    if (!this.sw.isEnabled) return false;
+    let knownManifest = false;
+    const subscription = this.sw.versionUpdates.subscribe((event) => {
+      if (event.type === 'NO_NEW_VERSION_DETECTED') knownManifest = true;
+    });
+    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
+    try {
+      return await Promise.race([
+        this.sw.checkForUpdate().then((ready) => ready || knownManifest),
+        new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
+          timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 30_000);
+        }),
+      ]);
+    } finally {
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      subscription.unsubscribe();
+    }
+  }
+}

diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/shared/composition/chance-breakdown.service.spec.ts b/apps/web/src/app/shared/composition/chance-breakdown.service.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d774fc07
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/shared/composition/chance-breakdown.service.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,124 @@
+import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing'
+import { BreakpointObserver } from '@angular/cdk/layout'
+import { MatBottomSheet } from '@angular/material/bottom-sheet'
+import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog'
+import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar'
+import { of } from 'rxjs'
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+
+import { CompositionApiService } from '../../core/composition/composition-api.service'
+import { ProductAnalyticsService } from '../../core/analytics/product-analytics.service'
+import { CompositionOverlayGateService } from './composition-overlay-gate.service'
+import { ChanceBreakdownService } from './chance-breakdown.service'
+
+const breakdown = {
+  participantId: 'participant-private',
+  roleKey: 'player',
+  displayName: 'Private name',
+  chancePercent: 50,
+  referencePercent: 50,
+  adjustments: [],
+}
+
+type BreakdownResult =
+  | { ok: true; data: typeof breakdown }
+  | { ok: false; errorMessage?: string }
+
+async function setup(
+  desktop: boolean,
+  result: BreakdownResult = { ok: true, data: breakdown },
+) {
+  const getChanceBreakdown = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(result)
+  const dialogOpen = vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ afterClosed: () => of(undefined) })
+  const sheetOpen = vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ afterDismissed: () => of(undefined) })
+  const captureChanceBreakdownOpened = vi.fn()
+  const snackOpen = vi.fn()
+
+  await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
+    providers: [
+      ChanceBreakdownService,
+      { provide: BreakpointObserver, useValue: { isMatched: () => desktop } },
+      { provide: CompositionApiService, useValue: { getChanceBreakdown } },
+      { provide: MatDialog, useValue: { open: dialogOpen } },
+      { provide: MatBottomSheet, useValue: { open: sheetOpen } },
+      { provide: MatSnackBar, useValue: { open: snackOpen } },
+      { provide: ProductAnalyticsService, useValue: { captureChanceBreakdownOpened } },
+    ],
+  }).compileComponents()
+
+  return {
+    service: TestBed.inject(ChanceBreakdownService),
+    gate: TestBed.inject(CompositionOverlayGateService),
+    getChanceBreakdown,
+    dialogOpen,
+    sheetOpen,
+    captureChanceBreakdownOpened,
+    snackOpen,
+  }
+}
+
+const context = {
+  seasonId: 'season-1',
+  eventId: 'event-1',
+  roleKey: 'player',
+  participantId: 'participant-private',
+  formulaId: 'formula-private',
+  viewerParticipantIds: ['viewer-private'],
+  analyticsContext: {
+    event_id: 'event-1',
+    season_id: 'season-1',
+    troupe_id: 'troupe-1',
+    is_demo_troupe: false,
+    actor_scope: 'event_organizer' as const,
+  },
+  entryPoint: 'equipe_draw_step' as const,
+}
+
+describe('ChanceBreakdownService', () => {
+  it.each([
+    [false, 'bottom_sheet', 'sheetOpen'],
+    [true, 'dialog', 'dialogOpen'],
+  ] as const)('captures once after the successful %s overlay opens', async (desktop, presentation, overlay) => {
+    const harness = await setup(desktop)
+
+    await harness.service.open(context)
+
+    expect(harness[overlay]).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened).toHaveBeenCalledWith(context.analyticsContext, {
+      entry_point: 'equipe_draw_step',
+      presentation,
+    })
+    expect(harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened.mock.calls[0][0]).not.toHaveProperty('participantId')
+  })
+
+  it('does not capture when the breakdown API fails', async () => {
+    const harness = await setup(false, { ok: false, errorMessage: 'No access' })
+
+    await harness.service.open(context)
+
+    expect(harness.sheetOpen).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(harness.snackOpen).toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('does not capture when the overlay gate refuses the opening', async () => {
+    const harness = await setup(false)
+    expect(harness.gate.tryAcquireBreakdown()).toBe(true)
+
+    await harness.service.open(context)
+
+    expect(harness.getChanceBreakdown).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(harness.sheetOpen).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    harness.gate.release()
+  })
+
+  it('keeps the opened overlay usable if analytics capture fails', async () => {
+    const harness = await setup(false)
+    harness.captureChanceBreakdownOpened.mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('analytics') })
+
+    await expect(harness.service.open(context)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
+    expect(harness.sheetOpen).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+  })
+})

       if (isDesktop) {

+
+  private captureOpened(
+    context: ChanceBreakdownOpenContext,

+  ): void {
+    if (!context.analyticsContext || !context.entryPoint) {

+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+import { signal } from '@angular/core';
+import { TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
+import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { ChunkRecoveryDialog } from './chunk-recovery-dialog';
+
+describe('ChunkRecoveryDialog with real MatDialog', () => {
+  afterEach(() => TestBed.inject(MatDialog).closeAll());
+  it('renders approved copy, shared dismiss, primary action and retry feedback', async () => {
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({ imports: [ChunkRecoveryDialog] });
+    const busy = signal(false),
+      feedback = signal('');
+    const confirm = vi.fn(),
+      exit = vi.fn();
+    TestBed.inject(MatDialog).open(ChunkRecoveryDialog, {
+      data: { busy, feedback, canDismiss: true, confirm, exit },
+    });
+    TestBed.tick();
+    const dialog = document.querySelector('mat-dialog-container')!;
+    expect(dialog.textContent).toContain('Une mise à jour est nécessaire');
+    expect(dialog.textContent).toContain('Mets HatCast à jour pour continuer.');
+    expect(dialog.textContent).toContain(
+      'Les modifications non enregistrées peuvent être perdues.',
+    );
+    const buttons = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button'));
+    expect(buttons.map((b) => b.textContent?.trim())).toEqual([
+      'Mettre à jour et continuer',
+      'Plus tard',
+    ]);
+    buttons[0].click();
+    expect(confirm).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(exit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    buttons[1].click();
+    expect(exit).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    busy.set(true);
+    TestBed.tick();
+    expect(buttons.every((b) => b.disabled)).toBe(true);
+    busy.set(false);
+    feedback.set('Vérifie ta connexion');
+    TestBed.tick();
+    expect(dialog.querySelector('[role="status"]')?.textContent).toContain('connexion');
+    expect(buttons.every((b) => !b.disabled)).toBe(true);
+    expect(document.querySelector('.cdk-overlay-backdrop')).toBeTruthy();
+  });
+  it('offers only update and retry for initial failure', () => {
+    TestBed.configureTestingModule({ imports: [ChunkRecoveryDialog] });
+    const exit = vi.fn();
+    TestBed.inject(MatDialog).open(ChunkRecoveryDialog, {
+      data: {
+        busy: signal(false),
+        feedback: signal(''),
+        canDismiss: false,
+        confirm: vi.fn(),
+        exit,
+      },
+    });
+    TestBed.tick();
+    const button = document.querySelector('mat-dialog-container button') as HTMLButtonElement;
+    expect(button.textContent).toContain('Mettre à jour et continuer');
+    expect(document.querySelectorAll('mat-dialog-container button')).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(document.querySelector('mat-dialog-container')?.textContent).not.toContain(
+      'Retour à l’accueil',
+    );
+    expect(exit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/app/shared/pwa/chunk-recovery-dialog/chunk-recovery-dialog.ts b/apps/web/src/app/shared/pwa/chunk-recovery-dialog/chunk-recovery-dialog.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..b85b15b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/app/shared/pwa/chunk-recovery-dialog/chunk-recovery-dialog.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import { Component, inject, Signal } from '@angular/core';
+import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialogModule } from '@angular/material/dialog';
+import { MatButtonModule } from '@angular/material/button';
+import { HatcastDialogDismiss } from '../../dialog-chrome/hatcast-dialog-dismiss';
+
+export interface ChunkRecoveryDialogData {
+  busy: Signal<boolean>;
+  feedback: Signal<string>;
+  canDismiss: boolean;
+  confirm: () => void;
+  exit: () => void;
+}
+
+@Component({
+  selector: 'app-chunk-recovery-dialog',
+  imports: [MatDialogModule, MatButtonModule, HatcastDialogDismiss],
+  template: `
+    <h2 mat-dialog-title>Une mise à jour est nécessaire</h2>
+    <mat-dialog-content [attr.aria-busy]="data.busy()">
+      <img src="/icons/logo-hatcast-2.svg" width="44" height="44" alt="" />
+      <p>Mets HatCast à jour pour continuer.</p>
+      <p>Les modifications non enregistrées peuvent être perdues.</p>
+      <p role="status" aria-live="polite">
+        {{ data.busy() ? 'Vérification de la mise à jour…' : data.feedback() }}
+      </p>
+    </mat-dialog-content>
+    <mat-dialog-actions align="end">
+      <button
+        class="recovery-primary"
+        mat-flat-button
+        [disabled]="data.busy()"
+        (click)="data.confirm()"
+      >
+        Mettre à jour et continuer
+      </button>
+      @if (data.canDismiss) {
+        <app-hatcast-dialog-dismiss
+          label="plus_tard"
+          [disabled]="data.busy()"
+          (clicked)="data.exit()"
+        />
+      }
+    </mat-dialog-actions>
+  `,
+  styles: `
+    :host {
+      color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface);
+    }
+    mat-dialog-actions.mat-mdc-dialog-actions {
+      gap: 8px;
+      flex-wrap: nowrap;
+    }
+    .recovery-primary {
+      flex: 1;
+      min-width: 0;
+      height: auto;
+      white-space: normal;
+      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+      padding-block: 8px;
+    }
+    app-hatcast-dialog-dismiss {
+      flex: none;
+    }
+    button,
+    app-hatcast-dialog-dismiss {
+      min-height: 48px;
+    }
+  `,
+})
+export class ChunkRecoveryDialog {
+  readonly data = inject<ChunkRecoveryDialogData>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA);
+}

+    # index.html and ngsw.json name the current hashed chunks: always revalidate them.

+
+    location = /ngsw.json {

+
+    # A missing chunk after a deploy must fail as 404, not as index.html (text/html).
+    location ~ ^/[^/]+\.(?:js|mjs|css)$ {
+      try_files $uri =404;
+    }
+
     location / {
       try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;

+  "changes": [

+    "✨ Accueil — retrouve jusqu’à cinq spectacles à venir et ouvre l’agenda avec « Voir plus ».",

+    "🐛 Composition — si un autre organisateur déverrouille l’équipe, ton écran retrouve les actions disponibles."

+    "✨ My team — open your team, season and season statistics directly from the navigation menu.",
+    "✨ Home — see up to five upcoming shows and open your schedule with “See more”.",
+    "🔧 Home — “You're all caught up” fades after reading and no longer repeats on every visit.",
+    "🐛 Navigation — if a screen fails to load, a window offers to update HatCast.",
+    "🐛 Lineup — if another organizer unlocks the lineup, your screen restores the available actions."
+  ]

```
package com.hatcast.api.memberglance

import com.hatcast.api.agenda.UserAgendaRepository
import com.hatcast.api.agenda.dto.UserAgendaSeasonFilterDto
import com.hatcast.api.agenda.dto.UserAgendaParticipationFiltersDto
import com.hatcast.api.agenda.dto.UserAgendaTroupeFilterDto
import com.hatcast.api.auth.SessionUserPrincipal
import com.hatcast.api.avatar.AvatarService
import com.hatcast.api.memberglance.dto.MemberSeasonGlanceResponseDto
import com.hatcast.api.memberprofile.MemberProfileStatsProvider
import com.hatcast.api.participant.ParticipantRowPresentation
import com.hatcast.api.season.SeasonEntity
import com.hatcast.api.season.SeasonRepository
import com.hatcast.api.troupe.TroupeAccessService
import com.hatcast.api.troupe.TroupeMembershipRepository
import com.hatcast.api.troupe.TroupeMembershipStatus
import com.hatcast.api.user.MemberGender
import com.hatcast.api.user.UserMemberPreferencesService
import com.hatcast.api.user.UserRepository
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.ZoneId
import java.util.UUID

@Service
class MemberSeasonGlanceService(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val seasonRepository: SeasonRepository,
    private val membershipRepository: TroupeMembershipRepository,
    private val userAgendaRepository: UserAgendaRepository,
    private val statsProvider: MemberProfileStatsProvider,
    private val troupeAccess: TroupeAccessService,
    private val userMemberPreferencesService: UserMemberPreferencesService,
    private val avatarService: AvatarService,
) {
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    fun getSeasonGlance(
        userSlug: String,
        principal: SessionUserPrincipal,
        troupeId: UUID?,
        seasonId: UUID?,
    ): MemberSeasonGlanceResponseDto =
        getSeasonGlance(userSlug, principal, troupeId?.let(::setOf).orEmpty(), seasonId?.let(::setOf).orEmpty())

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    fun getSeasonGlance(
        userSlug: String,
        principal: SessionUserPrincipal,
        troupeIds: Set<UUID>,
        seasonIds: Set<UUID>,
    ): MemberSeasonGlanceResponseDto {
        val targetUser =
            userRepository.findBySlug(userSlug.trim())
                ?: throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Membre introuvable.")
        val targetUserId = targetUser.id
        val isSelf = principal.userId == targetUserId

        val participation = participationContext(targetUserId)
        val filterBarVisible = participation.filterBarVisible

        val resolvedSeasons =
            resolveSeasons(
                troupeIds = troupeIds,
                seasonIds = seasonIds,
                participation = participation,
            )

        requireCanViewGlance(
            principal = principal,
            targetUserId = targetUserId,
            seasons = resolvedSeasons,
        )

        val troupeMembership =
            membershipRepository.findByTroupe_IdAndUser_Id(resolvedSeasons.first().troupe.id, targetUserId)
                ?: throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Membre introuvable.")

        if (troupeMembership.status != TroupeMembershipStatus.ACTIVE) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Membre introuvable.")
        }

        val resolvedSeasonIds = resolvedSeasons.map { it.id }
        val stats = statsProvider.loadStats(resolvedSeasonIds, targetUserId)
        val monthlyChart = statsProvider.loadMonthlyChart(resolvedSeasonIds, targetUserId)
        val favoriteRoleCounts = statsProvider.loadFavoriteRoleCounts(resolvedSeasonIds, targetUserId)
        val selfPreferences =
            if (isSelf) {
                userMemberPreferencesService.getPreferences(targetUserId)
            } else {
                null
            }

        return MemberSeasonGlanceResponseDto(
            userId = targetUserId,
            userSlug = targetUser.slug ?: userSlug,
            displayName = selfPreferences?.memberDisplayName ?: troupeMembership.displayName,
            avatarUrl = ParticipantRowPresentation.avatarUrl(avatarService, targetUser),
            isSelf = isSelf,
            resolvedSeasonIds = resolvedSeasonIds,
            resolvedTroupeIds = resolvedSeasons.map { it.troupe.id }.distinct(),
            preferredRolesTroupeId = resolvedSeasons.map { it.troupe.id }.distinct().singleOrNull(),
            filterBarVisible = filterBarVisible,
            participationFilters =
                if (filterBarVisible) {
                    participationFilters(participation.troupeIds, participation.seasonIds)
                } else {
                    null
                },
            stats = stats,
            monthlyChart = monthlyChart,
            favoriteRoleCounts = favoriteRoleCounts,
            preferredRoleKeys =
                selfPreferences?.preferredRoleKeys,
            gender = MemberGender.effective(targetUser.gender).wireValue,
        )
    }

    private fun resolveSeasons(
        troupeIds: Set<UUID>,
        seasonIds: Set<UUID>,
        participation: ParticipationContext,
    ): List<SeasonEntity> {
        if (!troupeIds.all { it in participation.troupeIds }) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Troupe hors périmètre du membre.")
        }
        if (!seasonIds.all { it in participation.seasonIds }) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Saison hors périmètre du membre.")
        }
        val scoped = candidateSeasons(participation.seasonIds, troupeIds)
        val resolved = if (seasonIds.isEmpty()) scoped.filter(::isEligibleCurrentSeason) else scoped.filter { it.id in seasonIds }
        if (resolved.any { it.troupe.id !in troupeIds } && troupeIds.isNotEmpty()) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Troupe et saison incohérentes.")
        }
        if (resolved.isEmpty()) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, if (troupeIds.isEmpty()) "Aucune participation active." else "Aucune saison pour cette troupe.")
        }
        return resolved.sortedBy { it.startDate }
    }

    private fun candidateSeasons(
        seasonIds: Set<UUID>,
        troupeIds: Set<UUID>,
    ): List<SeasonEntity> =
        seasonIds.mapNotNull { id ->
            seasonRepository.findById(id).orElse(null)?.takeIf { season ->
                !season.archived && (troupeIds.isEmpty() || season.troupe.id in troupeIds)
            }
        }

    private fun isEligibleCurrentSeason(season: SeasonEntity): Boolean {
        val today = LocalDate.now(ZoneId.of("Europe/Paris"))
        return season.isActive && season.startDate != null && season.endDate != null &&
            !today.isBefore(season.startDate) && !today.isAfter(season.endDate)
    }

    private fun requireCanViewGlance(
        principal: SessionUserPrincipal,
        targetUserId: UUID,
        seasons: List<SeasonEntity>,
    ) {
        if (principal.userId == targetUserId) {
            return
        }
        seasons.map { it.troupe.id }.distinct().forEach { troupeAccess.requireActiveMember(principal, it) }
    }

    private fun participationContext(userId: UUID): ParticipationContext {
        val troupeIds =
            (
                userAgendaRepository.findParticipatingTroupeIdsFromSeason(userId) +
                    userAgendaRepository.findParticipatingTroupeIdsFromEventOnly(userId)
            ).toSet()
        val seasonIds =
            (
                userAgendaRepository.findParticipatingSeasonIdsFromSeason(userId) +
                    userAgendaRepository.findParticipatingSeasonIdsFromEventOnly(userId)
            ).toSet()
        return ParticipationContext(
            troupeIds = troupeIds,
            seasonIds = seasonIds,
            filterBarVisible = troupeIds.size > 1 || seasonIds.size > 1,
        )
    }

    private fun participationFilters(
        troupeIds: Set<UUID>,
        seasonIds: Set<UUID>,
    ): UserAgendaParticipationFiltersDto {
        val troupes =
            if (troupeIds.isEmpty()) {
                emptyList()
            } else {
                userAgendaRepository.findTroupeCatalogByIds(troupeIds).map { row ->
                    UserAgendaTroupeFilterDto(
                        id = row.id,
                        name = row.name,
                        slug = row.slug,
                    )
                }
            }
        val seasons =
            if (seasonIds.isEmpty()) {
                emptyList()
            } else {
                userAgendaRepository.findSeasonCatalogByIds(seasonIds).map { row ->
                    UserAgendaSeasonFilterDto(
                        id = row.id,
                        title = row.title,
                        slug = row.slug,
                        troupeId = row.troupeId,
                    )
                }
            }
        return UserAgendaParticipationFiltersDto(
            troupes = troupes,
            seasons = seasons,
        )
    }

    private data class ParticipationContext(
        val troupeIds: Set<UUID>,
        val seasonIds: Set<UUID>,
        val filterBarVisible: Boolean,
    )
}

```

package com.hatcast.api.memberglance

import com.hatcast.api.auth.SessionUserPrincipal
import com.hatcast.api.avatar.AvatarService
import com.hatcast.api.memberprofile.MemberProfileStatsProvider

import com.hatcast.api.season.SeasonRepository
